title: 第八章 抱团第九章 狂虎第十章 暗流
lines: 洛阳城的恐慌在蔓延。
富甲天——那个曾经在洛天王朝呼风唤雨的人物，一夜之间被废，与死人无异。无声无息，查无痕迹。
仿佛有一个鬼魂在洛阳城的夜色中游荡。
那些还活着的人，终于坐不住了。
“不能等了。”一个声音在密室中响起，“那个人想一个一个得复仇。我们必须抱团。”
密室内坐着六个人。
为首的是洛天王朝的镇南将军司马雄，元婴中期，生肖狂虎。十二年前，他亲自带人堵住了长孙府的正门，亲手斩杀了长孙岳的大伯长孙无青。那一刀，从肩头劈到腰腹，人分为二。
他左手边，是皇室供奉卫青岚，元婴初期，生肖魂羊。十二年前，他以灵魂攻击瘫痪了长孙府的防御阵法，让天阙宗的人长驱直入。死在他手上的，有长孙家的七名护卫。
右手边，是礼部侍郎顾云鹤，元婴初期，生肖影兔。十二年前，他在长孙府的后院大开杀戒，一人一剑，屠了长孙家好多口人，其中包括长孙岳的两位堂姐。
对面坐着三个人——结丹后期的散修雷万山，结丹中期的万宝阁副总管金满堂和结丹中期的御林军副统领赵铁衣。
六个人，六双手上都沾着长孙家的血。
“司马将军说得对。”顾云鹤点头，“那个人只敢找落单的下手。我们六个人在一起，他不敢来。”
“不敢来？”卫青岚冷笑一声，“他能废了富甲天，你觉得他不敢来？”
“富甲天算什么东西？”顾云鹤不屑道，“一个结丹。我们这里有三个元婴，还怕他？”
司马雄抬手打断两人的争执。
“不管他敢不敢来，我们都不能坐以待毙。”他的目光扫过在场所有人，“从现在起，六个人同进同出，吃住都在一起。我已经在府中布下了天罡伏魔阵，还从暗市请了一位元婴后期的散修——‘铁牛’熊霸坐镇。此人是蛮牛生肖，力大无穷，肉身强横，曾以一己之力斩杀过元婴圆满的对手。只要他敢来，就叫他有来无回。”
听到“熊霸”两个字，在场的人都松了一口气。
元婴后期，蛮牛生肖，力大无穷。
那个人再强，也不可能是熊霸的对手。
洛阳城外，山神庙。
长孙岳坐在正房的蒲团上，面前摊着苏远山刚送来的情报。
纸条上只有几行字，但每一个字都像一根针，扎在他心上。
“司马雄、卫青岚、顾云鹤、雷万山、金满堂、赵铁衣。六人已齐聚司马府。府中有元婴后期散修‘铁牛’熊霸坐镇。”
长孙岳将纸条捏碎，灰烬从指缝间飘落。
元婴后期。
他闭上眼，深吸一口气，然后缓缓吐出。
小白虎从他腿边站起来，金色的眼睛盯着他，像是在问：怕了？
长孙岳睁开眼，目光平静。
“不怕。”他说，“元婴后期又如何？”
他站起身。小白虎跳上他的肩头。
龙蛋还在屋中，蛋壳上的裂纹又浅了几分，金色的纹路愈发密集，像一张正在织就的网。他能感觉到蛋里的生命气息越来越强，距离破壳的日子，越来越近了。
content_en:
Panic is spreading in Luoyang City.
Fu Jiatian, the man who once made all the changes in the Luotian Dynasty, was deposed overnight and was no different from a dead person. Silent, no trace.
It seems like there is a ghost wandering in the night of Luoyang City.
Those who were still alive finally couldn't sit still.
"We can't wait any longer." A voice sounded in the secret room, "That person wants revenge one by one. We must stick together."
There were six people sitting in the secret room.
The leader is Sima Xiong, the Zhennan general of the Luotian Dynasty. He is in the middle stage of Yuanying and his zodiac sign is Tiger. Twelve years ago, he personally led people to block the main entrance of Changsun Mansion and killed Changsun Yue's uncle Changsun Wuqing with his own hands. That knife struck from the shoulder to the waist and abdomen, splitting the person into two.
To his left is Wei Qinglan, a royal enshrinement, in the early stage of Yuanying, whose zodiac sign is Soul Sheep. Twelve years ago, he used his soul attack to paralyze the defensive formation of Changsun Mansion, allowing the people of Tianque Sect to march straight in. Among those who died in his hands were seven guards from the Changsun family.
On the right is Gu Yunhe, the Minister of Rites, who is in the early stage of Yuanying and whose zodiac sign is Shadow Rabbit. Twelve years ago, he went on a killing spree in the backyard of Changsun Mansion. With one man and one sword, he slaughtered many members of Changsun's family, including Changsun Yue's two cousins.
There were three people sitting opposite - Lei Wanshan, a casual cultivator in the late stage of the pill formation, Jin Mantang, the deputy general manager of Wanbao Pavilion in the middle stage of the pill formation, and Zhao Tieyi, the deputy commander of the Royal Forest Army in the middle stage of the pill formation.
Six people and six hands were stained with the blood of the Changsun family.
"General Sima is right." Gu Yunhe nodded, "That person only dares to attack those who are alone. There are six of us together, and he doesn't dare to come."
"Don't you dare to come?" Wei Qinglan sneered, "He can destroy Fu Jiatian, do you think he doesn't dare to come?"
"What does Fu Jia Tian mean?" Gu Yunhe said disdainfully, "A pill formation. We have three Nascent Souls here, are we still afraid of him?"
Sima Xiong raised his hand to interrupt the dispute between the two.
"Whether he dares to come or not, we can't sit still and wait for death." He glanced at everyone present, "From now on, the six of us will go in and out together, and we will eat and live together. I have already set up the Tiangang Demon-Conquering Array in the house, and also sent people from the dark market to We have invited a late-stage Nascent Soul cultivator - 'Iron Bull' Xiong Ba. This person is of the zodiac sign of the ox, and is extremely powerful and physically powerful. He has single-handedly killed Yuanying Perfection's opponents, and I will never come back."
Upon hearing the word "Xiong Ba", everyone present breathed a sigh of relief.
In the late Nascent Soul, people born under the zodiac sign of the Bull are extremely powerful.
No matter how strong that person is, he can't be Xiong Ba's opponent.
——
Outside Luoyang City, there is a mountain temple.
Changsun Yue sat on the futon in the main room, with the information just sent by Su Yuanshan spread out in front of him.
There were only a few lines on the note, but every word was like a needle piercing his heart.
"Sima Xiong, Wei Qinglan, Gu Yunhe, Lei Wanshan, Jin Mantang, and Zhao Tieyi. The six of them have gathered in Sima Mansion. There is Xiong Ba, the late Nascent Soul casual cultivator in the mansion, who is in charge."
Changsun Yue crushed the note into pieces, and ashes fell from between his fingers.
The late Nascent Soul period.
He closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and let it out slowly.
The little white tiger stood up from his legs and stared at him with its golden eyes, as if asking: Are you scared?
Changsun Yue opened his eyes with calm eyes.
"Don't be afraid," he said, "What about the later stage of Nascent Soul?"
He stood up. The little white tiger jumped on his shoulder.
The dragon egg is still in the house, the cracks on the eggshell are a little lighter, and the golden lines are getting denser, like a web being woven. He could feel that the life breath in the egg was getting stronger and stronger, and the day of breaking out of the egg was getting closer and closer.
